data.description: Captivating views and a luxury lifestyle, experience the “Big City Life” in Dubai Marina!

about.data:
Marina Cove at Dubai Marina is a distinguished residential development by Emaar Properties, enhancing the iconic skyline with its striking presence. It offers luxurious waterfront living, complemented by breathtaking marina views, world-class amenities, and seamless access to the city’s vibrant lifestyle.

This 32-story high-rise showcases a premium selection of apartments, ranging from 1 to 4-bedroom units. The development is equipped with facilities, including a swimming pool, fitness center, children's play area, landscaped terrace, and more.

With direct access to the Dubai Marina Mall, Pier 7, and the vibrant Marina Promenade, Marina Cove offers the best of Dubai's retail, dining, and leisure experiences just steps away.

Introducing Franck Muller Vanguard Dubai, a groundbreaking collaboration between London Gate and the iconic Swiss watchmaker Franck Muller. Rising 38 stories in the heart of Dubai Marina, this architectural marvel offers premium studios to 3-bedroom apartments inspired by the legendary Vanguard timepiece collection. Designed by Dar Design & Architecture Bureau, the tower blends Swiss precision with cutting-edge modern design, creating an extraordinary waterfront lifestyle. The development features 4 basements, a ground floor with retail, 3 podium levels, and 34 residential floors—each offering panoramic views of the Marina and city skyline.

More than just residences, these fully furnished luxury apartments reflect the bold spirit of innovation and sophistication. Every detail—from sleek open layouts to high-end finishes—echoes a commitment to craftsmanship and style. Exclusive amenities include a rooftop pool, serene meditation areas, a chic social lounge, and a co-working space for modern professionals. Situated in Dubai Marina, one of the city’s most dynamic neighborhoods, Franck Muller Vanguard connects residents to world-class dining, leisure, and cultural destinations, making it the perfect blend of visionary architecture and refined living. This is where timeless design meets a future-forward lifestyle.

Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina, a distinguished development by IHG Hotels & Resorts and Select Group, sets a new standard for luxury living. Showcasing expert craftsmanship and cutting-edge design, this unique destination offers an unmatched lifestyle at one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.

The residences boast a variety of layouts including 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units, as well as exclusive 4-bedroom half-floor penthouses, 4-bedroom duplex sky mansions, and expansive 5-bedroom triplex sky mansions. 

Each floor plan at Six Senses Place is meticulously designed to maximize space and comfort. Towering 122 stories, Six Senses Dubai Marina promises breathtaking views and an extraordinary living experience in the bustling heart of the city. With the anticipated handover of Six Senses, these residences are a prime opportunity for discerning buyers.

data.answer:
Dubai Marina, a meticulously planned community, is a project of master developer Emaar Properties, who turned a 3.5 km strip of shoreline into a 6,452,391 sq. ft. modern neighborhood. Potential buyers and tenants can choose from a range of luxurious apartments in high-rise buildings in this upscale neighborhood of Dubai.

Dotted with luxurious hotels such as the Address Dubai Marina, Grosvenor House, and others, offering upscale accommodations and amenities, the area offers residents a vibrant lifestyle. The Dubai Marina area is well-connected by public transportation, including the Dubai Metro and the Dubai Tram, making it easy for residents and visitors to move around.

Dubai Marina combines modern living, leisure, and entertainment, making it a popular destination for residents and tourists seeking a luxurious and dynamic experience in Dubai. Moreover, Dubai Marina is all set to be home to the ‘tallest clock in the world. Although the area is geared towards apartment living, there are also some podium villas to pique the interest of investors looking for houses for sale in Dubai Marina.

Dubai Marina offers a diverse range of floor plans to cater to different lifestyles and preferences, featuring options from compact studios and one-bedroom apartments to spacious multi-bedroom units and luxurious penthouses. Many buildings also provide unique duplexes and townhouses with varying layouts to suit individual needs. Dubai Marina floor plans are designed to maximize space, natural light, and waterfront views, often including modern amenities and high-end finishes to enhance the living experience.

Compact and typically suitable for individuals or couples, studio apartments in Dubai Marina provide a single open space combining living, dining, and sleeping areas. 1-bedroom apartments usually feature a separate bedroom, a living room, a kitchen, and one or more bathrooms. 2-bedroom apartments are suitable for small families or individuals looking for additional space. Larger families or individuals seeking more space can opt for 3-bedroom apartments in Dubai Marina, which offer three separate bedrooms, a living area, a kitchen, and multiple bathrooms. 

Luxurious and spacious penthouses are often located on the top floors of high-rise buildings in Dubai Marina, featuring expansive living spaces, multiple bedrooms, private terraces, and panoramic views of the marina and the city. Duplexes are two-level apartments, providing residents with a sense of space. Standard configurations include a living area and kitchen on one level, with bedrooms on the other.

You can find service apartments for short-term stays in Dubai Marina city. Also, some buildings in Dubai Marina offer apartments within or adjacent to hotels, providing residents with access to hotel services and amenities. Apartments in Dubai Marina are available in both furnished and unfurnished options, allowing residents to choose based on their preferences and needs. Given its prime location along the marina, many apartments offer stunning waterfront views, providing residents with a picturesque and serene living environment.

Popular Buildings in Dubai Marina

Where to live in Dubai Marina? What are the best towers to live in Dubai Marina? If you have these questions in mind, we are here to help! The community has a block of supertall skyscrapers, including some of the world’s largest residential towers. These towers offer a wide range of property types.

DEC Towers is a complex of two buildings offering studios and 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments. The residential tower is one of the top buildings for buying apartments in Dubai Marina. Marina Diamond is also a popular option for renting and purchasing properties. It has six mid-rise residential buildings with apartments ranging from studios to 1, 2 and 3-bedroom units. 

Marina Gate is another great option for renting apartments in Dubai Marina. It is a freehold project by Select Properties featuring a complex of two residential towers and one serviced apartment tower. One of the tallest residential towers in the area, Princess Tower is home to around 763 units of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses. 

Manchester Tower is also famous for buying properties. It is a 30-story tower featuring a mix of studios and 1 to 3-bedroom apartments. Also known as the Infinity Tower, Cayan Tower is an architectural marvel that features a distinctive twisted design, making it one of the most recognizable landmarks in Dubai Marina. The skyscraper is a project of Cayan Real Estate Investment and Development.

Marina 101 is a popular skyscraper in Dubai Marina and one of the tallest residential buildings in the world. The 101-story tower offers amazing accommodations and facilities, including the upscale Hard Rock Hotel. The Address Dubai Marina is a prominent hotel and residential development. The hotel is known for its contemporary design and luxurious amenities, providing guests with a premium lifestyle experience.

Marina Heights Tower is a prominent high-rise residential building in Dubai Marina, offering luxurious apartments with stunning views of the marina and the city skyline. The tower features top-notch amenities, including a swimming pool, gym, and 24-hour security, catering to a premium lifestyle.

Off-Plan Projects in Dubai Marina Area

Various projects have been launched in the luxury community, drawing the attention of both investors and home buyers. Check out the top upcoming properties to explore in Dubai Marina.

Habtoor Grand Residences

Experience luxury at Habtoor Grand Residences in Dubai Marina, a distinguished project by Al Habtoor Group spanning 50 levels above the ground. It features 2 to 4-bedroom flats, 3 to 4-bedroom townhouses and expansive 5-bedroom penthouses.

Franck Muller Aeternitas Tower

The world's tallest residential clock tower by London Gate is set to break records in Dubai Marina. The 1 to 4-bedroom residences in Franck Muller Aeternitas Tower will offer breathtaking ocean and marina views. 

Liv Waterside

A project by Liv Developers, Liv Waterside offers waterfront living in a private, gated enclave along the scenic Marina Promenade. It features 1- to 3-bedroom apartments with premium amenities and eco-friendly living.

Jumeirah Living Marina Gate

Indulge in supreme luxury with Jumeirah Living Marina Gate by Select Group, where the fusion of Jumeirah Group's renowned hospitality meets exceptional residences. 

Marina Shores by Emaar Properties

A 53-story tower provides direct access to the Marina Promenade with memorable views. Explore Damac's exclusive collection, Marina Shores, featuring super luxury 5-BHK penthouses.

Liv Lux

Explore coastal living at Liv Lux, where residences include 1- to 2-bedroom apartments, signature 2- to 4-bedroom apartments and lavish penthouses. It enjoys a prime location in one of the world’s most sought-after neighborhoods.

Cavalli Tower

Experience exclusivity at Cavalli Tower by Damac Properties, the world's first Cavalli-branded property. This 70-story architectural marvel overlooks The Palm. The building has 1- to 3-bedroom beach-facing apartments.

Liv Marina

Immerse yourself in luxury at LIV Marina by Liv Developers, featuring high-end studios, 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, and penthouses in Dubai Marina.

Renting a Property in Dubai Marina

You can find many properties for rent in Dubai Marina, including apartments, villas and penthouses. With a skyline adorned by modern architectural marvels, these apartments boast breathtaking views of the marina and beyond. Whether you seek a cozy 1-bedroom retreat or a spacious residence with multiple bedrooms, Dubai Marina provides diverse rental options to suit various lifestyles. 

Here are the starting prices of each type of apartment in Dubai Marina.

  • Prices for rental studios in Dubai Marina start from AED 70k. 
  • 1-bedroom apartments for rent in Dubai Marina cost around AED 75k per annum. 
  • The starting price of 2-bedroom apartments for rent in Dubai Marina is AED 120k. 
  • 3-bed flat for rent in Dubai Marina is available for AED 200k

Dubai Marina city, known for its iconic skyline, also offers an exclusive collection of luxurious villas that redefine waterfront living. Nestled in the heart of the vibrant district, these villas provide a unique blend of sophistication and tranquility. You can find spacious 2 to 5-bedroom villas. 2-bedroom Dubai Marina villas for rent start from AED 120k. 3-bed villas for rent in Dubai Marina costs around AED 220k. A 4-bedroom villa for rent in Dubai Marina is available at a starting price of AED 675k.

Slightly rarer to find are the deluxe penthouses for rent in Dubai Marina, which come in 4- and 5-bed configurations. These luxury units have unique amenities like private pools, elevators, and more. The rent for 5-bedroom penthouses in Dubai Marina can cost anywhere from AED 850k to AED 3M per annum.

Buying a Property in Dubai Marina

You can find a collection of high-end properties for sale in Dubai Marina. There are many choices if you are looking for an apartment in Dubai Marina.

Are you looking for apartments for sale in Dubai Marina? These configurations are available in the community. Also, note the starting prices of each unit type.

  • To buy a studio in Dubai Marina, you might spend around AED 560k. 
  • Prices for 1-bedroom apartments for sale in Dubai Marina begin from AED 999k. 
  • A bigger unit, like a 2-bed flat for sale in Dubai Marina, is available for AED 1.8M. 
  • There are 3-bedroom Dubai Marina flats for sale available for AED 4.1M.

The sales price of a 2-bed villa in Dubai Marina starts from AED 3.2M. Marina Quays and The Jewels are some considerable projects for this option. A 3-bedroom villa in Dubai Marina can cost anywhere between AED 4M to AED 10.5M. The larger 4-bedroom villas for sale in Dubai Marina are available in a price range of AED 18.9M. And, buying luxurious 5-bedroom villas in Dubai Marina can cost over 19M.

Prices rise to AED 49M for buying penthouses in Dubai Marina. These higher-end priced units are fully furnished apartments in the Dubai Marina area covering an area of 3,851 sq. ft. to 15,270 sq. ft. The starting price for 5-bed penthouses for sale in Dubai Marina is AED 8.4M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Marina?

data.answer:
Is it good to stay at Dubai Marina? Absolutely! Residents enjoy many upscale amenities, from world-class restaurants and high-end boutiques to pristine beaches and exclusive yacht clubs. The Marina Walk, a scenic promenade lined with cafes and shops, provides a perfect setting for strolls with breathtaking views. 

The expatriate community thrives in this dynamic locale, fostering a diverse cultural atmosphere. Whether enjoying panoramic sunsets, indulging in fine dining, or partaking in water sports at Marina Beach, Dubai Marina epitomizes a lifestyle of luxury and modernity. These are the reasons why Dubai Marina is so expensive.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Dubai Marina

Dubai Marina has two metro stations: Sobha Realty Metro Station and DMCC Metro Station. The roads tend to get busy in the evenings, so the metro can be an excellent way to shorten your time to get home after work. Getting around the neighborhood is much easier with the Dubai Tram. You can take a tram from DMCC Metro Station that will take you to Dubai Marina Mall. However, metros are usually very busy during rush hours, 7 to 9 am and 5 to 7 pm.

Dubai Marina offers ample parking options for residents, visitors, and businesses. Most residential buildings provide dedicated spaces based on apartment size. Commercial buildings and retail outlets offer employee and customer parking, while several RTA-managed paid parking lots are available throughout the area. Dubai Marina Mall provides free parking for short visits, with paid options for longer stays.

Supermarkets in Dubai Marina

Marina Mall, one of the best retail options for luxury goods in Dubai, houses Waitrose Supermarket, where residents can easily get their grocery shopping done. Apart from Waitrose, popular supermarkets in Dubai Marina are Spinneys, West Zone Supermarket, and Al Maya, catering to the day-to-day needs of tenants and homeowners. 

Shopping Mall in Dubai Marina Dubai

Dubai Marina Mall, located conveniently on Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), offers residents a variety of retail options, covering everything from high-street fashion to retail stores, a supermarket, and more. There are many facilities in Dubai Marina Mall besides shopping, such as banks, a supermarket, a pharmacy, and salons. Also, you can dine at the various F&B outlets or catch a movie at Reel Cinemas.

Dubai Marina Walk is also home to various shops, boutiques, and cafes, making it a popular spot for residents and visitors to stroll and explore. Moreover, numerous fashion boutiques are scattered throughout Dubai Marina, showcasing international and local designers and providing residents with diverse fashion options.

Schools and Nurseries in Dubai Marina Area

Raffles Nursery offers an Early Years Curriculum for children from 45 days to 4 years old. It is located on Marina Walk. There are no schools in the Dubai Marina area. However, nearby communities have excellent options, such as Emirates International School, Horizon International School, Dubai British School and King’s School Dubai. 

Horizon International School is located a 12-minute drive away from Dubai Marina on Street 9A in Umm Al Sheif. Dubai British School in Springs 3 and King’s School Dubai in Umm Suqeim 3 offer the British curriculum. All these globally-recognized schools are excellent nearby options for the community's residents.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Dubai Marina Location

Like most residential areas in Dubai, there is a mosque in Dubai Marina area. Masjid Al Rahim at the Marina Walk can hold up to 2,000 worshippers simultaneously. It opened in 2014 and is now regarded as one of the most beautiful mosques in Dubai.

Located in Dubai Marina, Al Rahim Mosque is also a notable place of worship for residents. Masjid Al Rahma and Masjid Al Rahman are the other famous mosques in the Dubai Marina vicinity. Masjid Al Salam is a popular mosque in the Al Sufouh area, close to Dubai Marina.

A group of churches clustered together in Jebel Ali, 15 minutes away from the community. Here, you can find some of the best churches in Dubai, including St. Francis of Assisi Church, also known as Jebel Ali Church, United Christian Church of Dubai and Dubai Mar Thoma Church. Sikh residents can visit the Guru Nanak Darbar, while the nearest temple is Shiva Temple, 25 minutes away in Bur Dubai.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Dubai Marina Area

The neighborhood also houses medical clinics. These include Medcare Medical Centre Marina and Emirates Hospitals Clinic. Al Zahra Hospital and Saudi German Hospital in Al Barsha are nearby options for Dubai Marina residents.

Dubai Marina Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Marina is centrally located in the city, opposite Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT) between Dubai Media City and Jebel Ali Freezone. The strategic Dubai Marina location provides residents and visitors stunning panoramic sea views. Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) and Palm Jumeirah are also close to the district. Apart from the elegant appeal of life by the water, many residents prefer the place due to its proximity to business districts like DIFC and Dubai Internet City.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Marina Area

data.answer:
Tourists and residents never run out of exciting things to do in Dubai Marina. From thrilling activities to calming long walks, there’s a complete package for people of all ages.

Dubai Marina Restaurants

Living in Dubai Marina will have you spoilt for choice for dining out. First, Marina Walk is lined with al fresco cafés and restaurants with delicious cuisines worldwide to entice your taste buds. These include Tony Roma’s, Maxine, and La Pergola Restaurant and Cafe. 

Dubai Marina has a wide variety of other casual restaurants, fine dining options, and nightspots. The area attracts visitors from all over the city, so restaurants are often packed on the weekends. Perfetto Pizzeria, Itsu, and The Acai Spot. Fresh Fish Restaurant and Bob’s Fish and Chips are a few of the best restaurants in the Dubai Marina for seafood.

Also, dining at one of the 7 fine-dining restaurants in the hugely popular Pier 7 is an absolute must. The stunning circular building offers fantastic views of the Dubai skyline and has a different restaurant on each of its seven floors – a culinary adventure you can’t miss!

Moreover, foodies can head to the top restaurants in Dubai Marina Mall, serving various cuisines. These include Eeten, Indian Access, and Doner and Gyro’s. There are many bars in Dubai Marina. Popular ones are near the Yacht Club, such as Shades, Cargo Dubai and Atelier M.

The area has a little bit of everything for you to choose from. Barasti Beach and Zero Gravity are some of the best options for nightlife in Dubai Marina. Zeta Seventy Seven, Bla Bla Dubai and Rex Bar Dubai are some of the top bars in Dubai Marina area.

Beaches Near Dubai Marina

To indulge in watersports, you can head to JBR Beach. This popular beach place is easily accessible from most towers via Dubai Tram. Visitors can enjoy various activities, including water sports, parasailing, banana boating, and wakeboarding. The other open beach is over in Jumeirah, a 30-minute drive away.

Hotels in Dubai Marina Area

The Address is one of the top 5 star hotels in Dubai Marina area, directly linked to the Marina Mall. All suites and rooms in the hotel offer views of the stunning marina and access to many luxurious amenities such as a spa, fitness center, infinity pool and more. A more suitable option for business travelers would be Stella Di Mare, Dubai Marina. However, the hotel also has family suites. 

One of the best hotels in Dubai Marina area has a ballroom for events, a spa, a gym and restaurants. Another option in the neighborhood, Grosvenor House, is a luxury collection hotel with 750 guest rooms, a terrace pool and a private beach.

Likewise, Rove Dubai Marina is a suitable option for leisure travelers looking for a reasonably priced place to stay in Dubai’s iconic waterfront community. Vida Dubai Marina and Yacht Club is for those interested in yacht tours and views.

Le Royal Meridien Beach Resort & Spa is another 5-star resort overlooking the marina. The hotel offers guests temperature-controlled swimming pools and tennis courts as sports amenities. Those looking for dining options can visit the 14 outlets in the hotel itself or take a short walk down to JBR.

La Verda Suites & Villa is a slightly different hotel experience, as it offers larger properties such as villas and duplex penthouses. Guests can opt for the 24-hour butler service as well. The hotel provides professional childcare services and activities specially designed for children. Moreover, Rixos Premium Dubai JBR and Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach are some of the top hotels near Dubai Marina area.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Dubai Marina Walk is lined with eateries and offers residents a great outdoor area for long walks, evening runs and even cycling. The 7-km promenade has bike rental stations where you can rent a bicycle for a ride around the town and take in beautiful views of the yachts moored at the marina as you cycle. Quad bikes for children are also available on Marina Walk.

For fitness enthusiasts, there are various workout studios and gyms in Dubai Marina area to pick from. Popular options are Fitness First, Iconic Fitness, TribeFIT, and NRG Fitness. You can also head out for early morning yoga sessions at JBR Beach in cooler months. Also, note that most residential towers in Dubai Marina have state-of-the-art gym equipment.

Dubai Marina salons and spas are known for providing delightful massages, scrubs and facials. The Spa, located in The Address Hotel, is a top favorite, along with Talise Ottoman Spa at the Jumeirah Zabeel Saray in Palm Jumeirah. Those looking to reset and rejuvenate can also head to the various yoga spots in Dubai Marina.

Community Events

Emaar hosts children’s events along Marina Walk to keep the little ones happy and entertained. Additionally, the cooler months usually buzz with outdoor craft markets at the marina promenade, featuring handicrafts and specialty products by local small business owners.

Dubai Marina Attractions and Landmarks

The waterfront lifestyle is a major part of the appeal for those living here. Is it worth going to Dubai Marina? Yes! Besides enjoying stunning views, visitors will never run out of things to do in Dubai Marina area as it offers plenty to entertain you. 

Marina Walk is situated along the Dubai Marina Canal, providing stunning views of the marina, yachts, and the iconic skyline of Dubai. Marina Walk often hosts street performers, creating a lively and entertaining atmosphere for residents and visitors. You might also encounter musicians, artists, and other performers, enhancing the overall experience.

To experience a little of the sea life around which the Marina is built, you can head down to the Dubai Marina Yacht Club and charter a yacht. The club also offers numerous outlets for watersports enthusiasts, including fishing, wakeboarding, jet skiing, flyboarding and more.

For a more luxurious experience on the marina, guests can opt for a dhow cruise. Dhow cruises in Dubai Marina are popular for sightseeing and dining over the water. Dubai Marina Mall also offers multiple leisure activities besides shopping and dining options. Jump N Fun, Dubai Marina Mall children's play area provides little ones with many fun activities.

While living in Dubai Marina has its perks, there are a few things to know before you decide to move to this neighborhood. Despite being one of the most well-connected areas in Dubai regarding public transport, the roads tend to get congested, especially during rush hour. Public parking spaces are limited, so those visiting friends or family in Marina might be better off taking a cab or catching a metro ride.

Where to live in Dubai Marina?

Those looking to move to this part of Dubai can choose from various apartments for rent. Some residential towers also feature podium villas, which families prefer. If you are planning a short or long stay, there are various hotels, waterfront resorts, and reasonable hotel apartments in Dubai Marina area.

Can I walk around Dubai Marina? How long is the walk around Dubai Marina?

The Dubai Marina Walk spans approximately 7 kilometers (4.3 miles) along the waterfront. Completing the entire length requires about 1.5 to 2 hours at a moderate walking pace.

Is it better to stay in Marina or Downtown Dubai?

The choice between staying in Dubai Marina or Downtown Dubai depends on your preferences and priorities. Dubai Marina offers stunning waterfront views and a vibrant atmosphere with various restaurants, cafes, and nightlife options.

Downtown Dubai has iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall. This area might be ideal if you prefer being close to major attractions. Also, note that Downtown Dubai is a business district, so if you are visiting Dubai for business, staying in Downtown Dubai might offer more convenience.

Is Dubai Marina and JBR the same?

Marina and JBR are two different communities. There is a distance of less than 1 kilometer from Marina to Jumeirah Beach Residence.

Who is the owner of Dubai Marina?

Emaar Properties developed the community of Dubai Marina, and its design is attributed to HOK Canada.

Can we swim in Marina Beach Dubai?

There is no designated beach known as Dubai Marina. It is a functional waterway with a high volume of yachts, boats, and other watercraft; therefore, it is not recommended for swimming. Fortunately, numerous alternatives exist in the vicinity, such as the public beach at Jumeirah Beach Residence and pools at nearly every hotel in Dubai Marina.

How To Go To Dubai Marina By Metro?

DMCC Metro Station serves the community — Dubai Marina Mall is a few steps away from the station.

Can you walk from Dubai Marina to Palm Jumeirah?

It’s not feasible to walk from Dubai Marina to Palm Jumeirah. You should take a taxi that will take you to the island in 16 minutes.

Is Dubai Marina man-made?

Yes, it is entirely man-made.

Where are the best fine-dining restaurants In Dubai Marina?

Some of the best fine-dining restaurants in Dubai Marina include Pier 7, Massimo's Italian Restaurant, and Indego by Vineet.

When was Dubai Marina built?

Dubai Marina construction began in 2003 and was largely completed by 2008.

How can you invest in off-plan projects in Dubai Marina?

To invest in off-plan projects in Dubai Marina, you can contact real estate developers directly, consult with real estate agents, explore listings on property portals, and attend property exhibitions. Ensure review of the developer's reputation, payment plans, and project timelines.

data.content:
Dubai Marina is a contemporary, opulent waterfront location that resonates with Dubai's magnificence and charm. Tucked away along the Persian Gulf coast, it is renowned for its exciting nightlife, sophisticated dining options, and dynamic lifestyle.

From popular restaurants to vibrant nightclubs, Dubai Marina offers various entertainment options to residents and visitors. Enjoy the exciting water activities at Marina Beach, including yacht cruises and water sports, or stroll down the charming Marina Walk, lined with cafes, shops, and recreational spaces.

The district offers many housing options, from luxurious flats to upscale penthouses with unmatched views of the surrounding waterways. You can also find a large selection of luxurious hotels and hotel apartments in the Dubai Marina area.

nodes.title: Palm Beach Tower 1
nodes.about:
Palm Beach Tower 1, a tower located on Palm Jumeirah Island, is the first building in the prestigious Palm Beach Towers development by developer Nakheel. The complex is designed in a modern urban style. The design of the towers was developed by a large company WS Atkins & Partners. The complex includes residential apartments, stores, as well as a beach club with a park. Apartments are presented with 1-4 bedrooms, as well as two-story penthouses with 4 bedrooms. All residences are exquisitely finished with premium quality materials. Apartments are equipped with balconies, which opens a gorgeous view of the coast.

Residents will enjoy a variety of recreational amenities including: yoga area, gym, playground and sports facilities, spa, private beach, waterfront park and promenade, outdoor infinity pool, observation deck, retail stores, lounge, cafe, multi-purpose room, indoor and outdoor children's play areas.

The development is located at the entrance to the iconic Palm Jumeirah Island, providing residents with easy access to the Dubai mainland. Within walking distance of the skyscraper are 2 streetcar stations - Palm Jumeirah 1 and Palm Jumeirah 2. Residents will have easy access to key areas of the rest of the emirate: travel time to Dubai Marina will take 10 minutes, and Business Bay and Downtown Dubai can be reached in 20 minutes. Dubai International Airport is 30 minutes away.

nodes.title: Silverene Towers
nodes.about:
Silverene Towers is the perfect choice for those dreaming of modern and comfortable living in the heart of Dubai Marina. This residential complex, divided into two buildings, embodies luxury and convenience. Tower A, with its 35 floors, and Tower B, consisting of 26 floors, are both connected by a common podium. Silverene encompasses all the benefits of waterfront living, topped by a unique interior treatment and a captivating glass and mirror effect that reflects the blue waters and maximizes the breathtaking view on each floor. There are a mix of studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, duplexes and penthouses.

The amenities are not limited to just the interior of the apartments. Safety is a priority here, with round-the-clock security and concierge services available 24/7. Residents can use basement parking, and for those who aspire to a healthy lifestyle, the complex features a fitness center and pools for both adults and children. There's also a playground for the little ones.

Nearby, you'll find the Marsa Dubai bus stop and the DMCC metro station, providing convenient access to any point in the city. And, of course, high-end restaurants like Bazerkan Lebanese Restaurant and La Gaufrette, as well as Carrefour Market supermarket, are located near Silverene Towers. And if you decide to spend a day shopping, Dubai Marina Mall is just a 5-minute walk away. Also it takes roughly 22 minutes to drive to Dubai Mall, 14 minutes to Palm Jumeirah, 20 minutes to Burj Al Arab and 6 minutes to The Walk JBR.

nodes.title: Vida
nodes.about:
Vida is a luxury development by developer Emaar, located in the heart of Dubai Marina. The complex is an elegant 57-storey building and offers spacious apartments with 1-4 bedrooms and functional layouts.

The developer has taken care of maximum comfort, providing residents with a unique set of amenities:

  • Gym with modern equipment
  • Swimming pool with a relaxation area
  • Sauna and spa
  • Children's playgrounds
  • Conference hall.

The complex also offers concierge services and 24-hour security. Vida is strategically located close to Dubai's most important motorways. JBR Beach and Marina Mall are just 5 minutes away, Palm Jumeirah and Ibn Battuta Mall are 10 minutes away and Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport are 20 minutes away.

The tower's striking nautical-themed architecture makes it truly unique and distinctive, with glass facades combined with wood panelling to create a cosy and tranquil atmosphere. The interiors of the residences combine contemporary design, stylish finishes and carefully selected colour schemes, with breathtaking views of the waterfront, bay and Dubai Marina Yacht Club.

nodes.about:
Pelagos by Invest Group Overseas (IGO) is a new residential tower in the highly sought-after Dubai Marina. Standing 35 floors tall, the building offers studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, all featuring fully fitted Smeg kitchens and premium Toto sanitary ware. The building will undergo full renovation and refurbishment, ensuring modern and luxurious living spaces for residents.

Situated in a prime location, Pelagos is just a short walk from DMCC and Sobha Realty metro stations, providing convenient access to Downtown Dubai and other key areas. The development is surrounded by restaurants, shopping malls, and beaches, making it an attractive choice for residents and investors. The high demand for rentals, combined with Dubai Marina's prestige and developed infrastructure, ensures strong investment potential. Major shopping centers and airports are also within proximity.
